options.title: What's Under St Peter's Basilica?
options.first_line: What's under the floor of St Peter's Basilica in Rome?
options.first_frame: The great dome of St Peter's in Rome in golden light with people crossing the square, the ground cut away below it showing dark earth, the depth meter at zero.

options.title: How Deep Does St Peter's Basilica Go?
options.first_line: St Peter's Basilica sits on something far older. How deep does it go?
options.first_frame: St Peter's dome with a name plate and people walking in the square, the camera starting to tip down into the earth, the depth meter at zero.

options.title: What's Buried Under the Vatican?
options.first_line: Under the Vatican's biggest church, something Roman is buried. What is it?
options.first_frame: The dome of St Peter's at sunset, people in the square, lamps glowing in the earth under the floor, the depth meter at zero.

why: Naming the Vatican's biggest church and saying something Roman is buried under it makes a stranger ask what it is, without giving the answer, and the lamps glowing in the earth under the floor tease it even with the sound off.
